import Mathlib
open scoped ENNReal NNReal MeasureTheory
open Set MeasureTheory
noncomputable section
namespace ProductInterval
abbrev V (n : ℕ) := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)
def interval : Set ℝ := Set.Icc 0 1
def appendCoord (n : ℕ) (p : V n × ℝ) : V (n + 1) :=
  (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ).symm
    (Fin.snoc ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin n) ℝ) p.1) p.2)
def euclideanProduct (n : ℕ) (E : Set (V n)) : Set (V (n + 1)) :=
  appendCoord n '' (E ×ˢ interval)
end ProductInterval
namespace ProductInterval
def F (n : ℕ) (E : Set (V n)) : Set (V n × ℝ) := E ×ˢ interval
def D (n : ℕ) (E : Set (V n)) : ℝ := (dimH E).toReal
end ProductInterval

conclusion.statement: For every integer n≥0 and every nonempty compact E⊆Euclidean ℝ^n, the coordinate copy of E×[0,1] in Euclidean ℝ^(n+1) has Hausdorff dimension dimH E+1. The coordinate copy consists of (x₁,…,x_n,t) with x∈E and 0≤t≤1; for n=0 it is the unit interval in Euclidean ℝ. Hausdorff measures use the unnormalized diameter-power convention and dimH∅=0.

retained.statement: The given subset E of Euclidean ℝ^n is compact; n is the given arbitrary nonnegative integer.
The given subset E of Euclidean ℝ^n is nonempty.
